description: This file defines the GameView class, a custom Android View used for rendering the TicTacToe game board, managing user interactions, and displaying game states such as player moves and winning lines.

classes.name: GameView
classes.description: A custom View class for rendering the TicTacToe game board, handling touch inputs, game state management, and visual representation, including player moves, game-winning lines, and cell selection effects.

classes.name: GameView.State
classes.description: An enum representing possible states of a cell: UNKNOWN, WIN, EMPTY, PLAYER1, and PLAYER2, with helper methods for conversions.

classes.name: GameView.ICellListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to cell selection events on the game board.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles the drawing of the game board, player moves (bitmaps), and winning lines on the canvas.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Ensures the view remains square by adjusting dimensions during measurement.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Calculates cell sizes and offset positions when the view's size changes.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Manages user touch input to select cells, toggle selection, and trigger blinking effect.

methods.name: stopBlink
methods.description: Stops the blinking animation and clears the selection highlight.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current game state, including cell data, selection, and visual effects, for state restoration.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores the game state from a saved Parcelable, including cell data, selection, and blinking state.

methods.name: getResBitmap
methods.description: Loads a bitmap resource with fallback for graphical layout editor compatibility.
